text:
ash: FYI — scheduled canary for gateway service tonight 23:00 UTC. Short window, low-risk but DB schema change in migration step. Leaving notes for whoever's oncall.

maria: Thanks — what's the freeze window?

ash: Freeze from 22:30 -> 00:30 UTC. No non-emergency infra changes during that time.

samir: Can you paste the rollback threshold and the smoke checklist?

ash: Rollback if error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m or p95 latency spikes > 200ms above baseline. Quick smoke checklist (run after canary reaches 10%):
- curl -sSf https://api.staging.example.com/health
- POST /v1/generate quick prompt, expect 200 and token stream
- DB read/write: psql -c 'SELECT 1' against canary DB replica
- Check redis cache hitrate for gateway namespace

lee: Who's on rotation for watchers?

ash: @maria will be primary for first 30m, @samir backup. I'll be reachable for rollback steps.

maria: I'll be on watch starting 22:45 UTC, have the smoke script open.

samir: I'll take alerts and paging, have runbooks pinned.

ash: Deploy bot will post status; if deploy-bot shows any FAILED or ROLLBACK events, escalate immediately.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @ash — gateway-canary v3.2.0 -> starting at 23:00 UTC. Canary traffic: 10% -> 50% after 15m if health ok.

maria: Noted. Any DB migration details?

ash: Migration is online-safe but adds a new index and a small alteration. Run in preflight container step. Command: 
```
kubectl -n infra exec preflight-migrator -- psql $CANARY_DB -c "BEGIN; ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN user_agent_hash varchar(64); CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON events (user_agent_hash); COMMIT;"
```
It does use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY so shouldn't lock writes, but watch replica lag. If replica lag > 2m, abort migration and rollback.

samir: I'll watch replica lag metric and set a short alert.

ash: Post-deploy smoke runbook snippets:
```
# check rollout
kubectl -n gateway rollout status deploy/gateway-canary --timeout=5m
# smoke test (curl)
curl -o /dev/null -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" "https://canary.api.example.com/health"
```

lee: Any post-deploy config flips?

ash: Yes — feature flag gate.enable_new_routing will be toggled at 50% traffic. We keep it off until 50% green.

maria: I'll run the smoke script at 23:20 and post results here. If anything odd I'll tag @samir and escalate.

ash: Thanks. Small note: metrics may show a transient CPU bump on the ingress nodes for the first 5m — expected. If CPU remains >85% on gateway nodes for >10m, start rollback.

samir: Acknowledged — alerts set.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% traffic — health OK.

maria: 23:22 smoke results: health 200, generate OK (latency 180ms), DB select OK, replica lag 0s. All green. :white_check_mark:

ash: Great. Proceed to 50% at 23:40 if no regressions. I'll update if I need to trigger rollback.

samir: Will monitor error budget and p95.

lee: thanks for the heads up — will keep an eye on infra alerts.

ash: Leaving handover — primary oncall tonight is @maria until 00:30 UTC, backup @samir. If anything comes up after 00:30 ping me and we can coordinate a follow-up window.

maria: Copy.

samir: Copy.
